messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have a tool that searches for or provides documentaries directly. My current function can retrieve information about scientific research papers (e.g., title, authors, abstract, year), but it doesn’t handle films or documentaries.

If you’d like, I can look up a highly cited research paper on global warming from a specific year or author, summarize its findings, and give you key points that might help you locate a related documentary. Let me know if that would be helpful!
